sse-l4.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure
sse-l4.raw_text:
About the Team:
Cloud Infrastructure team builds and maintains the core platform that powers all of Example Tech's products. We handle petabytes of data, serve billions of requests daily, and ensure 99.99% uptime. Our tech stack includes Go, Python, Kubernetes, and AWS.

Responsibilities:
- Design and build highly scalable distributed systems
- Improve system reliability and performance
- Mentor junior engineers and drive technical excellence
- Participate in on-call rotation

Minimum Qualifications:
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Strong proficiency in Go, Python, or Java
- Experience with distributed systems and microservices
- Bachelor's degree in CS or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration
- Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
- Experience with high-traffic production systems
- MS in Computer Science

application_status.next_steps: Prepare for technical round 2 - System Design interview on Jan 20
referrals: Zhang Wei (L5 Engineer at Example Tech)

notes.note: Phone screen with recruiter went well. Moving to technical round 1

research_notes.company_culture: Fast-paced, data-driven, emphasis on technical excellence. Known for 'move fast and break things' philosophy but with strong engineering practices. Good work-life balance compared to other Big Tech. Focus on impact and ownership.
research_notes.interview_process: Typical process: 1) Recruiter screen (30 min) 2) Technical screen (1 hour, LeetCode-style) 3) System design (45 min) 4) Onsite: 3-4 back-to-back interviews including coding, system design, and behavioral. Total process takes 2-4 weeks.
known_questions: Behavioral: Tell me about a time you had to make a difficult technical decision
Behavioral: Describe a situation where you had to mentor a junior engineer
tips: Focus on system design trade-offs and scalability
Be prepared to discuss past projects in depth
Show enthusiasm for distributed systems and infrastructure
Example Tech values 'bias for action' and 'customer obsession' - give examples
Prepare questions about team culture and tech stack
